item.title: Bulletin updated at 20:00 HKT 21/May/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A broad trough of low pressure will bring showers to the northern part of the South China Sea and southern China in the next couple of days. The weather will become unsettled over the coast of Guangdong midweek next week. Under the influence of a southwesterly airstream, it will be hot with a few showers over the coast of southern China towards the weekend.

Date/Month: 22/05 (Sunday)

Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers. Sunny periods during the day.

R.H. range: 70 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
